description: Routing of specialist roles and required convergence gates by project class. Roles are registered in config/agent-roles.json.

product.label: Product scope, journeys and acceptance criteria

information-architecture.label: Sitemap, navigation, taxonomy and content hierarchy

ux.label: Task flows, state coverage and recovery

content.label: Copy quality, voice and claim discipline

brand.label: Brand fidelity against supplied and observed evidence

architecture.label: Data model, auth, tenancy and API boundaries

design-system.label: Token, component, motion and accessibility contract completeness

functionality.label: Acceptance journeys work in a real browser

responsive.label: Composition holds at every declared width

accessibility.label: No serious/critical automated failures and manual findings resolved

seo.label: Crawlability, metadata, structured data and evidence-backed local signals

security.label: Auth, tenancy, input, secrets, storage and deployment boundaries

provenance.label: Every published fact and asset retains source and rights state

tests.label: Coverage, regression protection and deterministic checks

launchability.label: The build is genuinely ready to launch

marketing-site.label: Marketing / local-business website
marketing-site.notes: Brand, art direction, conversion copy and SEO/AEO carry real weight here.

content-site.label: Content / editorial site
content-site.notes: Same shape as a marketing site; collections and editorial rhythm dominate composition.

b2b-saas.label: B2B SaaS application
b2b-saas.notes: Architecture, tenancy and security dominate. No separate brand/art-direction stage by default.

consumer-app.label: Consumer application
consumer-app.notes: Adds brand and art direction to the application pipeline.

ai-app.label: AI-first application
ai-app.notes: Application pipeline plus brand/art direction; AI capability budgets are part of the architecture stage.

internal-tool.label: Internal tool
internal-tool.notes: Deliberately omits research, brand, art direction, marketing content, SEO and red team to avoid spending context on work the project does not need.
